text:
marie: Hey @eng-runtime — quick request for the launch post. We need reproducible perf artifacts and the exact methodology so marketing can cite numbers. Specifically: median/95th/99th latency, tokens/sec, and a cost estimate per 1M tokens. Also need the runbook (commands), sample prompts, warmup protocol, and whether numbers are quantized vs fp16. We're aiming to publish Tues.

devon: Got it — do you want raw CSVs + summary or just a one-pager?

marie: Both please. One-pager for the post + raw CSVs/logs so analysts can verify. Also: include the model variant names we used, kernel/commit hash, and exact sequence-length buckets.

ryan: We can run a focused sweep. Clarify model & buckets: which model variant (redwood-v1-large/quant) and seq buckets? Also traffic profile — single QPS baseline or sustained?

marie: Use redwood-v1-large quant-8bit for headline values, and fp16 in appendix. Buckets: 32-64, 128-512, 1024-2048. Traffic: baseline 1 qps, a warmup burst to 20 qps for 30s, then sustained 5 qps for steady-state. Cost calc based on hosted pricing (marketing will link internal pricing page).

devon: OK. We'll do a smoke run today and full sweep tomorrow AM. We'll attach: perf CSVs, raw logs, commit hash, and a small reproduce script. Example command we'll use: 

```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-v1-large --quant q8 --batch 1 --seq 512 --samples 2000 --warmup 100 --out perf.csv
```

runtime-bot: smoke run started on cluster-a-3 (job 61234). ETA ~45m.

ryan: Note: quantized variants occasionally show higher 99th variance at 2048. We'll capture median/95/99 + stddev and annotate known caveats. Commit used: runtime@a1b2c3d (kernel v2.4-opt).

anya: Can you include two one-liners we can paste into the marketing appendix: 1) short explanation of why median vs 95th matter, 2) why warmup is necessary for quantized runtimes?

devon: Yep. We'll add a README.txt with: methodology, exact CLI, docker image (redwood/benchmark:2026-03), reproduce.sh, and a small explainer for metrics. We'll upload artifacts to GCS: gs://redwood-marketing/launch-bench/1765432100/

marie: Amazing. Can we get the smoke CSVs by EOD PST and the full artifacts + README by Monday AM? If anything slips, please update this thread.

runtime-bot: smoke run completed. Output: perf.csv uploaded to gs://redwood-marketing/launch-bench/1765432100/smoke/perf.csv. Job 61234 success :white_check_mark:

devon: Smoke looks clean. 32/128 buckets show low variance; 2048 quant has a few spikes — we'll capture those in the notes and run the full sweep tomorrow morning.

marie: Perfect. If the full sweep shows >10% variance on our headline bucket we'll fallback to median-only and add a clarification in the post. Thanks all :pray:
